chessground 9.2.1, GPL-3.0-or-later, https://github.com/lichess-org/chessground
chess.js 1.4.0, BSD-2-Clause, https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js (minified with esbuild, otherwise unmodified)
lichess "sfx" sounds by Enigmahack, AGPL-3.0-or-later, https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/sound/sfx (fallback only)
chess.com default sounds are loaded from https://images.chesscomfiles.com/chess-themes/sounds/_MP3_/default/ at runtime and are not part of this repository
phosphor-icons/core 2.1.1, MIT, https://phosphoricons.com (20 icons inlined as an SVG sprite in index.html)
Fraunces (variable, latin subset from Google Fonts), SIL OFL 1.1, https://github.com/undercasetype/Fraunces
IBM Plex Mono 400 and 500 (latin subset from Google Fonts), SIL OFL 1.1, https://github.com/IBM/plex
